verdict.rationale: No built-in bulk-edit feature is documented. Bulk operations are only implied by indirect routes. Notes are plain Markdown files that external scripts or agents can process en masse. The plugin API's Vault interface lets custom TypeScript code act on files and folders. The Importer converts whole workspaces at once. missing for 10: documented native multi-select/bulk edit, rename, move or delete across notes; bulk property updates via Bases; a first-party scripting or CLI path for batch operations; hands-on corroboration.
